categories.name: Waterhole tokens
categories.description: Add up the values on your face-down waterhole tokens (1 to 3 each).

categories.name: Oasis tokens
categories.description: 5 points for each oasis token: one per caravan linked to an oasis, including oases inside your enclosed areas.

categories.name: Largest caravans
categories.description: 10 points for each caravan token: you had the largest caravan of that color.

categories.name: Tied caravans
categories.description: 5 points for each color where you tied for the largest caravan.

categories.name: Enclosed areas
categories.description: 1 point per empty space inside your enclosed areas. Oases do not count.
